_about: Thoth correspondence lexicon. Curated starter set: dream/vision symbols and their associations across the traditions named in the Thoth system prompt. Presented as resonance, never as fixed meaning. Extend freely — add objects to 'symbols'. 'aliases' are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries against what Velle says.

correspondences.Egyptian: Wadjet / Uraeus — sovereignty and protection; Apep, the chaos-serpent devoured nightly by Ra
correspondences.Hermetic: Ouroboros — the all-is-one, prime matter cycling end into beginning
correspondences.Gnostic: the Naas — serpent as bringer of gnosis (the Ophite reversal of Eden)
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Nachash; the serpent-path winding down the Tree of Life
correspondences.Jungian: instinctual libido and the chthonic unconscious; the ambivalent wisdom that renews by shedding its skin

correspondences.Egyptian: the Wedjat (Eye of Horus) — healing and wholeness restored; the Eye of Ra — sovereign, destructive feminine fire
correspondences.Hermetic: the all-seeing Nous, mind perceiving itself
correspondences.Gnostic: the eye of gnosis against the blind Demiurge (Samael, 'the blind god')
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the supernal eyes of Arikh Anpin, an unblinking flow of mercy
correspondences.Jungian: the observing ego and the eye of the Self; consciousness watching itself, the still centre of the mandala

correspondences.Egyptian: Nun, the primordial waters; the Nile inundation as renewal
correspondences.Hermetic: the moist nature; the watery substance of the Poimandres vision
correspondences.Gnostic: the waters above and below; the descent and baptism of the soul
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Mayim; Chesed as water; the lower waters that wept at separation
correspondences.Jungian: the unconscious itself — the maternal deep into which the ego dissolves and is reborn

correspondences.Egyptian: Ra and the Aten; Khepri the morning becoming, Atum the evening close
correspondences.Hermetic: the visible god, the solar Nous radiating
correspondences.Gnostic: the true Light beyond the rule of the archons
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Tiferet, the Sun at the heart of the Tree, harmonizing the pillars
correspondences.Jungian: consciousness at its height; libido as life-force, the solar hero and the father principle

correspondences.Egyptian: Thoth and Khonsu, keepers of lunar reckoning and the waxing eye
correspondences.Hermetic: the reflective sphere, threshold of generation
correspondences.Gnostic: the sublunar realm ruled by fate (heimarmene)
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Yesod, the Moon, foundation that reflects Tiferet into the world
correspondences.Jungian: the reflective feminine, the anima; the unconscious giving its borrowed, cyclical light

correspondences.Egyptian: Horus the falcon; the Ba (soul) as a human-headed bird returning to the body
correspondences.Hermetic: the ascent of the soul shedding its bodily weight
correspondences.Gnostic: the light-spark in flight upward past the powers
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the soul-bird; the wings of the Shekhinah; the nest (qen) on high
correspondences.Jungian: spirit and intuition; the soul ascending, thought taking flight toward the transpersonal

correspondences.Egyptian: Sekhmet, the solar lioness of plague and protection; Aker, the twin horizon-lions guarding yesterday and tomorrow
correspondences.Hermetic: fixed fire, the Leonine heat of the work
correspondences.Gnostic: Yaldabaoth the lion-faced (leontoeides) archon-craftsman
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Gevurah, severity; the lion of Judah on the right of the Throne
correspondences.Jungian: raw instinct and devouring passion that the hero must master; the solar animal of the will

correspondences.Egyptian: the lakes of fire in the Duat that purify or consume the dead
correspondences.Hermetic: the creative, demiurgic fire — the artificer mind
correspondences.Gnostic: purifying flame against the false fire of the archons
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Esh; Gevurah; the consuming flame upon the altar
correspondences.Jungian: libido as transformative psychic energy — passion, purgation, the heat of the opus

correspondences.Egyptian: the ished-tree on which Thoth and Seshat inscribe the king's name; the sycamore of Nut and Hathor
correspondences.Hermetic: the world-tree, the cosmos as a single growth
correspondences.Gnostic: the Tree of Knowledge re-read as a gift of the Light (Ophite)
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Etz Chayim — the Tree of Life itself, ten sefirot in array
correspondences.Jungian: the growth of the Self and the axis of individuation; the maternal tree of life rooted in the unconscious

correspondences.Egyptian: the maqet, the ladder set up so the deceased may climb to the sky
correspondences.Hermetic: the planetary ascent, shedding a vice at each sphere
correspondences.Gnostic: the rise through the archontic spheres, a password at each gate
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Jacob's ladder, the sulam joining the worlds, angels going up and down
correspondences.Jungian: the graded ascent of individuation, the rungs joining conscious and unconscious

correspondences.Egyptian: the imperishable flesh of the gods
correspondences.Hermetic: the perfected solar metal, end of the Great Work
correspondences.Gnostic: the incorruptible light-substance hidden in matter
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the radiance of Tiferet; the gold of the inner sanctuary
correspondences.Jungian: the incorruptible Self, goal of the alchemical opus — the lapis won from base matter

correspondences.Egyptian: the hand-mirror of Hathor — to look in it is to meet the face of the goddess
correspondences.Hermetic: Anthropos seeing his image in the water and falling in love, and so falling
correspondences.Gnostic: Sophia's reflection casting the lower world into being
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the aspaklaria — the clear glass of true vision against the dim glass of dream
correspondences.Jungian: the confrontation with the shadow; projection made visible, self-reflection turned back on the ego

correspondences.Egyptian: Osiris; the weighing of the heart; the body made imperishable
correspondences.Hermetic: the death of the body releasing the immortal man
correspondences.Gnostic: the body as tomb (soma sema), the spark awaiting release
correspondences.Kabbalistic: mitat neshikah, the death by the kiss; Malkhut's descent and return
correspondences.Jungian: ego-death before rebirth; the nigredo, the necessary dissolution that precedes transformation

correspondences.Egyptian: Harpocrates / Hor-pa-khered, Horus the child, finger to his lips
correspondences.Hermetic: the reborn Nous, the mind made new
correspondences.Gnostic: the divine child, the Light-spark incarnate
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Ben, the Son (Tiferet); Zeir Anpin, the lesser countenance
correspondences.Jungian: the divine-child archetype — the emergent Self, wholeness arriving from the future

correspondences.Egyptian: the pharaoh as living Horus; the union of the Two Lands in the double crown
correspondences.Hermetic: the king as solar vicegerent of the cosmos
correspondences.Gnostic: the kingless generation (genea abasileutos), free of the archons
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Keter, the Crown, the first and highest sefirah
correspondences.Jungian: the realized Self and the totality of the integrated psyche; sovereignty over the inner kingdom

correspondences.Egyptian: the gates of the Duat, each with a guardian whose name must be known
correspondences.Hermetic: the planetary gates of the ascent
correspondences.Gnostic: the gates of the aeons, kept by powers demanding the password
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the fifty gates of Binah; the gate of tears that is never shut
correspondences.Jungian: the threshold to the unconscious; the liminal point of initiation and transition

correspondences.Egyptian: the benben, the first mound risen from Nun; Manu and Bakhu, the horizon mountains
correspondences.Hermetic: the ascent to the height, the climb out of the moist below
correspondences.Gnostic: the mountain of revelation where the risen one teaches
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Har, the mountain of the Temple; the soul's ascent to the heights
correspondences.Jungian: the goal and place of vision; the upward pull toward the Self, the sacred temenos

correspondences.Egyptian: the Duat; the hidden caverns of Sokar in the deep of night
correspondences.Hermetic: the cave of generation into which souls descend
correspondences.Gnostic: the dark hyle, matter as prison of the spark
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the Cave of Machpelah, a doorway to Eden; the depths beneath the Throne
correspondences.Jungian: the unconscious as maternal womb — the dark place of incubation, descent, and rebirth

correspondences.Egyptian: the blood of Isis (the tyet knot); the red of Set and the desert
correspondences.Hermetic: the vital spirit, life borne in the moist heat
correspondences.Gnostic: soul-substance caught and bound in flesh
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Dam — 'the life is in the blood'; the red of Gevurah
correspondences.Jungian: libido and life-essence; the vital substance offered in sacrifice and transformation

correspondences.Egyptian: the first light as Atum emerges from the waters
correspondences.Hermetic: the Light that is the Father and the Nous (Poimandres)
correspondences.Gnostic: the alien Light of the Pleroma, foreign to this world
correspondences.Kabbalistic: Or; the Or Ein Sof; the primordial light stored up for the righteous
correspondences.Jungian: consciousness and illumination; the lumen naturae, insight breaking from the unconscious

correspondences.Egyptian: Nun before creation; Kek, god of the primordial dark
correspondences.Hermetic: the moist dark nature recoiling as the Light appears
correspondences.Gnostic: the kenoma, the deficiency; the outer darkness
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the tehiru, the void left by the tzimtzum; choshekh
correspondences.Jungian: the unconscious and the shadow; the prima materia, the nigredo before the dawn

correspondences.Egyptian: the abtu and oxyrhynchus fish, ambivalent dwellers of the deep
correspondences.Hermetic: the sign of the moist generative power
correspondences.Gnostic: Ichthys; the netting and gathering of souls
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the letter Nun ('fish'), token of the world to come; Leviathan reserved for the feast
correspondences.Jungian: a content surfacing from the depths; the cold instinct, and the Self drawn up from the unconscious sea

correspondences.Egyptian: the heart weighed against the feather of Ma'at before Osiris
correspondences.Hermetic: the equilibrium of the four elements
correspondences.Gnostic: the reckoning demanded by the archons at each sphere
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the balance of the pillars of mercy and severity (moznayim)
correspondences.Jungian: the moral confrontation and the weighing of opposites; the balance held in enantiodromia

correspondences.Egyptian: the ankh, the key of life held to the lips of the dead
correspondences.Hermetic: the key to the mysteries, given only to the prepared
correspondences.Gnostic: the keys and passwords carried past the gatekeepers
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the keys of the gates; the key of David that opens and none shuts
correspondences.Jungian: the gnosis that unlocks the unconscious; the function that opens the closed inner door

correspondences.Egyptian: the veil of Isis — 'no mortal has lifted my veil'
correspondences.Hermetic: the veil of Nature drawn over the mysteries
correspondences.Gnostic: the katapetasma, the veil that hides the Pleroma
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the parochet, the veil before the Holy of Holies
correspondences.Jungian: the threshold of the numinous; projection separating the ego from what it cannot yet face

correspondences.Egyptian: the descent into the Duat at the close of day
correspondences.Hermetic: Anthropos who fell through love of his own reflection
correspondences.Gnostic: the fall of Sophia, the spark cast down into matter
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the shevirah, the shattering, and the scattering of the sparks
correspondences.Jungian: the surrender of conscious control — the involuntary descent into the unconscious

correspondences.Egyptian: the ka, one's living double; Shu and Tefnut; Horus and Set in contention
correspondences.Hermetic: 'as above, so below' — the two natures of one thing
correspondences.Gnostic: the syzygy of paired aeons; the heavenly Twin who is one's true self
correspondences.Kabbalistic: the pairing of the sefirot; Metatron as the lesser likeness
correspondences.Jungian: the pair of opposites, ego and shadow; the doubled nature seeking its own union

correspondences.Egyptian: the ferryman Mahaf rowing the dead to the Field of Reeds
correspondences.Hermetic: the passage from the moist below to the dry height
correspondences.Gnostic: the crossing of the waters past the powers that bar the way
correspondences.Kabbalistic: crossing the Jordan; the river of light (Nahar di-Nur) before the Throne
correspondences.Jungian: the transcendent function — the crossing that unites conscious and unconscious
